name: Grafana
param_style: ? positional (xorm / database/sql); most SQL is text/template files rendered by sqltemplate (.Ident quoting, .Arg placeholders), the rest Go string building
schema_source: pkg/services/sqlstore/migrator/snapshot/00-schema.sql (migrator schema snapshot) converted to Grafana's SQLite dialect types, plus the alert_rule.k8s_status migration; only the tables the queries use
data_scale: scale 1: 2 orgs, 2000 users, 100 teams (5.7k members), ~16k permissions, 3450 legacy dashboards (14k versions), 3.3k resources + 11k resource_history rows, 50k annotations (115k tag links), 500 alert rules (3k versions)
visibility_note: 78k stars; SQLite is the default database for grafana.db on self-hosted installs
interest_note: Unified-storage history queries (GROUP BY max-version derived tables joined on 5 columns, NOT EXISTS trash, ROW_NUMBER() prune DELETE), annotation tag matching via correlated SUM(1) subqueries, permission resolution through a 3-way UNION of role assignments, correlated latest-user_auth joins.
reach_note: one of the most deployed dashboards; grafana.db is SQLite by default
